description: Decompresses gzip data, the inverse of the GZIP step. Takes base64 (or text), returns UTF-8 text (or base64 for binary content).
label: GUNZIP

options.name: data
options.label: Data
options.info: The gzip data to decompress, normally as a base64 string (it starts with H4sI). Set Input encoding to match.

options.name: input-encoding
options.label: Input encoding
options.info: Base64: Data is base64-decoded first (standard base64; line breaks are ignored). UTF-8 text: only for gzip data that is valid text, which is rare.

options.name: output-encoding
options.label: Output encoding
options.info: UTF-8 text: the decompressed data as text, e.g. XML. Base64: the decompressed bytes as base64, for binary content such as a PDF.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: The decompressed data, as text unless Output encoding says base64.
